codebook.name: Coupled livestock premia (special beef, suckler cow, slaughter and ewe premia)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: Reg. (EC) 1254/1999 and parallel sheepmeat regulations; decoupled 1 January 2005
codebook.coding_note: Coverage share: 2014 beef_sheep share transferred to the 1989 reference year, which precedes the inventory series (Low). Eligibility is upper-bound potential reach.

codebook.name: Milk quota increases (Agenda 2000 allocation; 2% in 2008; 1% p.a. 2009-2013)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: Reg. (EC) 1256/1999 (Agenda 2000, two steps 2000/01 and 2001/02); Commission Regulations on division of reference quantities [3-6]
codebook.coding_note: I = normalised cumulative quota increase z (Equation B.7; baseline 5,245,764 t, endpoint 5,784,422 t). 2000 = first Agenda 2000 step (~96,000 t); full 150,000 t from 2001. Coverage share: 2005 dairy share used for the 1999 reference year (Low).

codebook.name: Nitrates derogation (stocking above 170 kg organic N/ha)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: Decision 2007/697/EC; 2011/127/EU; 2014/112/EU; (EU) 2018/209; (EU) 2022/696; 220 kg N/ha in affected areas from 1 January 2024
codebook.coding_note: Eligibility steps at successive derogation decisions; 2022-2024 anchored on ~7,500 derogation dairy farms (~49% of dairy farms), emissions-weighted upward. 2024 I = blend of headroom ratio 0.625 (affected areas) and 1.00; alternative 0.89 on stocking exposure.

codebook.name: EU milk quota abolition
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: Reg. (EU) No 1308/2013; Implementing Reg. (EU) 2015/447 (final quota year)
codebook.coding_note: Quota ended 31 March 2015: nine quota-free months in 2015. B = 0.75 tested as alternative.

codebook.name: TAMS II Dairy Equipment Scheme (capital grants)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: RDP 2014-2020, TAMS II; opened 29 June 2015, closed 16 December 2022
codebook.coding_note: Eligibility between payment ratio 0.38 (5,778/15,300) and approvals ratio 0.58 (8,897/15,300); 2023 = run-off of approved claims.

codebook.name: Food Harvest 2020 (+50% milk volume target)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: DAFF (2010) Food Harvest 2020
codebook.coding_note: Non-binding strategy reported in G, not P. e = 1.00 denotes nominal sectoral reach. Content weight w = 1.00.

codebook.name: Food Wise 2025 (+65% primary production value)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: DAFM (2015) Food Wise 2025
codebook.coding_note: Published July 2015; end year is a non-overlap convention with Food Vision 2030. w = 1.00.

codebook.name: Food Vision 2030
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: DAFM (2021) Food Vision 2030 (published 3 August 2021)
codebook.coding_note: I = 1.00 records operative status; content weight w = 0.50 represents the expansionary share of a strategy pairing an export-value target with a 10% biogenic-methane target.

codebook.name: Rural Environment Protection Scheme (REPS 1-4)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: Reg. (EEC) 2078/92; closed to new applicants 9 July 2009
codebook.coding_note: Eligibility = 63,000/139,860 farms (0.45) x GLAS intensity ratio 0.79. Run-off: REPS 4 held >30,000 of ~63,000 participants.

codebook.name: Nitrates Action Programme (Good Agricultural Practice Regulations)
codebook.coding_note: In force 1 February 2006; storage requirements from 31 December 2008. Climate-relevance weight 0.50 used in a robustness variant only.

codebook.name: Farm Waste Management Scheme (revised, nitrates-driven)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: DAFF scheme launched March 2006; works and claims deadline 31 December 2008
codebook.coding_note: Eligibility: 41,750 approvals against 128,000-140,000 farms (0.30-0.33), weighted up to the livestock-holding base of the manure key.

codebook.name: Agri-Environment Options Scheme (AEOS)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: RDP 2007-2013; intakes 2010, 2011, 2013; final contracts ended 2018
codebook.coding_note: Eligibility: ~10% of farms x emissions-weighting factor 0.6-0.7. 2017-2018 residual = 2,117 contracts (~15% of plateau).

codebook.name: Carbon Navigator and advisory programmes
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: Teagasc/Bord Bia Carbon Navigator (2013); Signpost programme (2021)
codebook.coding_note: Eligibility counts only use outside the suckler programme; mandated completions 2015-2022 are scored in M08.

codebook.name: Sustainable Dairy Assurance Scheme (Origin Green)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: Bord Bia SDAS, launched December 2013
codebook.coding_note: 16,190 certified farms (~95% of dairy farms, 99% of milk). B = 0.50 tested as alternative.

codebook.name: Green Low-Carbon Agri-Environment Scheme (GLAS)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: RDP 2014-2020, Measure 10; contracts extended to 31 December 2022
codebook.coding_note: Eligibility = 48,806/139,860 x 4.1/5.2 (Equation B.9). I from participant series 21,792; 36,530; 49,102 (2017 peak).

codebook.name: Suckler genetics and data programmes (BDGP 2015-2022; BEEP-S 2019-2022; SCEP 2023-)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: RDP 2014-2020 (BDGP); DAFM exchequer scheme (BEEP-S); CAP Strategic Plan 2023-2027 (SCEP)
codebook.coding_note: Three overlapping schemes merged into one lineage. Eligibility = enrolment ratio x suckler-system factor (0.50, 0.465, 0.42); union exposure 0.70 in 2019-2022.

codebook.name: Chemical nitrogen maxima (5th Nitrates Action Programme increment)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: S.I. 113/2022 (in force 11 March 2022), amended by S.I. 393/2022
codebook.coding_note: Scored as the 10% cut in grassland chemical-N maxima only; LESS obligation and protected urea excluded from the baseline.

codebook.name: Agri-Climate Rural Environment Scheme (ACRES)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: CAP Strategic Plan 2023-2027
codebook.coding_note: Eligibility = paid participants (43,032; 45,702) / 133,174 farms x factor 0.70. 2023 = Tranche 1 only (43,032 of ~54,400).

codebook.name: Sustainable Beef and Lamb Assurance Scheme (Origin Green)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: Bord Bia SBLAS, introduced April 2017
codebook.coding_note: 53,295 certified farms (~92% of beef farms). Coverage share interpolated between the 2014 (0.4818) and 2019 (0.4388) beef_sheep shares; not computed directly for 2016 (Low).

codebook.name: Climate Action and Low Carbon Development (Amendment) Act 2021
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: Act No. 32 of 2021 (signed 23 July 2021)
codebook.coding_note: Event marker only; excluded from baseline sums. Robustness variant scores E01 and E02 in M at B = 0.25.

codebook.name: Agriculture sectoral emissions ceiling (-25% by 2030 vs 2018)
codebook.legal_or_programme_source: Government decision 28 July 2022
codebook.coding_note: Event marker only; excluded from baseline sums.
